phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: A developer clones, runs one command, and has the full stack running locally with two isolated tenants.
phases.exit: pnpm install && pnpm dev:stack && pnpm dev produces a running system; cross-tenant isolation test passes; audit chain verifier passes on seeded data.

phases.name: Ingest & Storage
phases.goal: Microsoft 365 events flow continuously into ClickHouse, normalised to OCSF, with no loss across an induced outage.
phases.exit: 72h continuous ingest; killing the connector mid-batch and restarting loses nothing and duplicates nothing observable downstream.

phases.name: Detection Engine
phases.goal: 40 MITRE-mapped detection rules evaluating in-stream at 30k EPS, each with a positive and negative fixture.
phases.exit: 40 rules green in CI; 30k EPS sustained load test; chaos test proves critical alerts survive an analyst outage.

phases.name: Correlation
phases.goal: Deterministic clustering of signals into cases, achieving at least a 10:1 noise reduction.
phases.exit: Reduction ratio >= 10:1 on replayed data; case state fully reconstructible from the append-only transition log.

phases.name: AI Analyst
phases.goal: LLM investigation producing plain-English reports where every claim is mechanically proven against a real logged event.
phases.exit: 100% of delivered reports pass grounding validation; eval suite green on 50 golden cases; per-tenant cost inside budget.

phases.name: Response & Alerting
phases.goal: Alerts on the owner's phone with a one-tap approval that executes a fix safely and auditably.
phases.exit: The 02:14 detect to 02:21 fixed scenario reproduced end to end in an automated test, every step in a verified audit chain.

phases.name: Product Surface
phases.goal: The dashboard, MSP console, weekly report and the free security scan that converts trials.
phases.exit: A pilot customer onboards unassisted in under 15 minutes and receives their first weekly report.

phases.name: Scale & Compliance
phases.goal: More connectors, sharding for hot tenants, cold tiering, and SOC 2 evidence.
phases.exit: 30k EPS sustained for one hour with p95 alert latency under 3 minutes; SOC 2 Type I evidence collected.
